title: 'A meaty book with lots of practical advice and a compelling business case'
summary: Julian Dunn — established Goodreads reviewer (402 reviews) — posts a substantive 4-star review calling Incorruptible a meaty, practical business case for going down the incorruptible path.
blockquote: Altogether this is a meaty book with lots of practical advice and lays out a compelling business case that companies who go down the path of becoming incorruptible last longer, deliver better returns to the market, and have happier customers and employees.
